verdict.rationale: The evidence covers inbound data collection only: snippet install, track and bulk-track APIs, identify, and user and account properties. Segment appears only as an install source. Nothing documents outbound event forwarding to CRMs, ad platforms or registrable webhooks. The 'Data warehouse integration' and 'CSV exports' pricing bullets are adjacent features, not documented event-streaming destinations, so they earn no credit.

support.subject: As a developer, I can stream events onward to third-party destinations (CRM, ad platforms, webhooks) from the analytics platform
